name: The Chill of Death
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
It's so cold, now.  The Plague of Undeath crawls through my veins like an icy serpent.  The Mindless State will be upon me soon.  But no doomed destiny will prevent me from serving our Dark Lady.  When the call arose I sewed body bags for the fallen soldiers of Sylvanas's mighty army.

Now my hands shake from the chill.  If you would bring me five Duskbat Pelts and some Coarse Thread I could sew myself a blanket.  Help me, adventurer, so that I can continue to serve the cause.
narrative.objectives: Bring five Duskbat Pelts and some Coarse Thread to Gretchen Dedmar in Brill.
narrative.offerRewardText: I appreciate your efforts, adventurer. May Slyvanas recognize your bravery one day. . . .
narrative.requestItemsText: Do you have five Duskbat Pelts and some Coarse Thread yet, adventurer?

objectiveItems.name: Coarse Thread
sources: sold by Gunder Thornbush and 4 more
